method: paired 2024-2025 redraft-only historical replay; pregame projections choose lineups; no waivers; no dynasty

interpretation.snake_baseline: ADP-first target team; identical competent ADP-driven opponents and seeds.
interpretation.auction_baseline: FFToday half-PPR $200 values; target bids to generic price while opponents use need-adjusted market bids.
interpretation.auction_scope: Validates roster-construction/max-bid mechanics against historical market prices, not your league-specific price model because Yahoo historical auction records are not yet available.
interpretation.lineup_policy: Weekly starters chosen only from that week pregame projections; scoring uses realized points.
interpretation.promotion_rule: Treat format as validated only when combined paired mean is positive and its 95% interval does not cross zero.
